title: Ukraine drone attacks cut power and water in Crimea, hit Russian petrochemical plant
summary_full: Ukrainian drone attacks led to significant disruptions in electricity and water supplies in Russian-occupied Crimea. As a result of drone incidents, restrictions on these utilities were implemented, although specific household counts were not provided. Meanwhile, drone strikes also targeted a petrochemical plant in Togliatti, causing explosions and fires. In response, Russia reported shooting down numerous Ukrainian drones while sustaining some injuries from falling debris.
